subject: Additional downstream predictive nodes are also being sampled by posterior_predictive sampler

messages.author: 79c3b52defbd0096
messages.subject: Additional downstream predictive nodes are also being sampled by posterior_predictive sampler
parts:
Dear All,

I am learning NIMBLE. I have a dependent variable (count data-number of cases named Cas in the code) and two predictors, one is a factor (named age_id ) and the other one is proportion (named Pov ). I would like to fit a GLM with NIMBLE. 

Below is how I have defined model code. Note that I have included e[i], which is the expected number of cases (named ExpCas in the code).

GPmodel<-nimbleCode({
  beta0 ~ dnorm(0,sd = 10000)
  beta1 ~ dnorm(0,sd = 10000)
  beta2 ~ dnorm(0,sd = 10000)
 
   for(i in 1:N){
    y[i] ~ dpois(mu[i])
    log(mu[i]) <- beta0 + beat1*x1[i] + beta2*x2[i] + e[i]
    theta[i]~dgamma(a,b)
    }
   a~dexp(0.1)
   b~dexp(0.1)
 
})

GPdata<-list(y=data1$cas)

GPconsts<-list(N=168,
               x1=data1$Pov,
               x2=data1$age_id,
               e=data1$ExpCas)
GPinits<-list(beta0=0, beta1=0, beta2=0, a=0.1 , b=0.1, theta=rep(c(1), times=GPconsts$N))




Now, the problem comes when configuring the model  i.e configureMCMC( )

I get the following note, which I believe affects the output, and I haven't found a way to correct that yet. 
           "  [Note] Additional downstream predictive nodes are also being sampled by    
             posterior_predictive sampler "
 
I also suspect I have incorrectly defined the model, but I can not trace the part. 


Your help will be greatly appreciated!

Regards,

Mwandida.
